negative.meaning: direction flag returned by Elo.ratingChange; true means eloB should decrease
negative.checkpoint: after Elo.ratingChange returns, before battleElo applies the update

change.meaning: rating change amount returned by Elo.ratingChange
change.checkpoint: after Elo.ratingChange returns, before battleElo applies the update

elo_b_after.meaning: eloB rating after battleElo applies change and negative

elo_b_expected.meaning: eloB rating required by the direction flag: prior eloB minus change when negative is true, plus change when negative is false

elo_b_prior.meaning: eloB rating before battleElo applies the update

dependent_data_correct.meaning: protocol functionality relying on Elo ratings operates on data consistent with the required rating direction
dependent_data_correct.checkpoint: after battleElo update, when dependent functionality reads ratings

assumptions: The rating change and direction flag are derived from battle results passed to battleElo.
The better-performing party's rating must not decrease; the report does not fix whether that party is eloA or eloB.
battleElo applies the returned change and negative to the simulated scores in a single update.

unresolved.description: Report does not fix which of eloA/eloB corresponds to the better-performing party, so the winner/loser mapping is left symbolic.
Report gives no concrete prior rating values or numeric change magnitude; only the direction relation is formalized.

limitations: Formalizes only the dependent_functions_use_incorrect_data impact via the direction-consistency relation; the separate winner/loser rating inversion impact is not covered here.
The dependent_data_correct symbol is a qualitative Boolean because the report does not define a numeric correctness metric for downstream consumers.
Only the negative=true branch is encoded in the condition; the negative=false branch is symmetric and not separately formalized in this pass.
